notes.title: v0.3 | 2-Star item upgrades
notes.content:
Patch v0.3Greetings, Oaklings! 

New Feature: 2-Star item upgrades.
2 x 1-Star items will now merge into a 2-Star item. 

This will combine the stats from the 2 items, and in some cases give a brand new effect!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/a24c5b00f669eee93416d21bc97719b2263b061d.png"]


Encounters:
Much balancing has been done in order to accommodate for the new 2-Star upgrades.



Priest encounter changed:

Healing touch --> Gain +80% max hp.

Blessing --> Gain +10 income. Gain +150 max HP now and for the next 2 days.



Celestia right option changed: Now upgrades a 2-Star item into 3-Star after 3 days.

The 3-Star items are powerful and unique!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/4b4d3923210f8dd2a2b49ab4f70e0e2ea70bf248.png"]



Celestia left option now gives +10 gold as well as the Mirror Elixir.



Cleric: 900/1500 Max HP --> 1500/2000 Max HP.

Miriel: Both options now give 2 hearts.

Take my bow (Elven Archer encounter): Gain a Regular Bow with +5 multicast --> +4 multicast.

New Carmen Lucky Reroll: Shop contains a Crownforge Brew.

The Chronomancer's Shop lucky reroll now has a lower chance for Time Tonics and Time Vials.


Balance:
🔸The effect "On First Trigger: Do X" is now a part of the game.



🟡Astral Hammer (Legendary): 30 damage --> 20 damage | 2 multicast --> 4 multicast.

Anvil (Legendary): 50 shield --> 40 shield.

🟡Natures Call (Epic): "After 3s in combat...." --> "On First Trigger"

🟢Solaris (Epic): 3s CD --> 2.9s CD | 1 multicast --> 2 multicast.

🟢Venom Ring (Legendary): 4.8s CD --> 4.6s CD.

🟢Spikey Mace (Rare): Start of Combat: Gain +4 damage per mace --> +5 DMG.

🟢Topaz Spear (Epic): 5s CD --> 4.6s CD.

🟡Wild Magic (Epic): Ability changed to only make "plain" copies of items. It will generate 1-star and 2-star items respectively when upgraded.



After much testing, gold-generating items were found to be very strong with 2-Star upgrades being available. They have been changed to be a bit more tempo-focused (Hook has more damage and provides less gold, Brass Knife gives more gold in first few triggers, but ramps down to 0).
🟡Brass knife (Rare): On Trigger: Gain 2 gold --> On Trigger: Gain +5 gold and reduce this amount by 1.

🟡Hook (Rare): --> 2.8s CD | 18 DMG | 25% crit | On Crit: Gain 2 gold.

🔴Midas Diary (Epic): On Trigger and when a dagger triggers: Gain +2 gold --> +1 gold. | 2s CD | 35 gold cost.

🟡Conjure Spear (Epic): On First Trigger: Generate 2 plain copies of spear to the right. | 10s CD.



Since this update took a lot of micro-tweaks here and there, there might be some balance changes I have missed. Forgive me ːcozyjunimogreenː


Fixes:
🔸Fixed a bug where you could not put Time Vial on an Elvish Orb.

🔸Fixed a bug where some items didn't show their arrow indicators.

🔸Fixed a bug where Cursed Garnet gave cursed items on trigger.


Other:
🔸The "Soft cap" on health has been increased to 18000. It has also been altered to give 1200 Max HP per level, decreasing to 550.

🔸There is now an ever so slight shop bias to make item types you already own a little bit more favoured to appear. (This slight increase will cap out at 4 owned items of a certain type. Triples count as 3).



As always, the PvP environment will need appx. 1 hour to adjust and rotate out old builds from the build pool.


Expect follow-up hotfixes and balance changes in the coming weeks.


//Bocary

notes.title: v0.2.9 | New Features
notes.content:
Patch v0.2.9Greetings, Oaklings! 

New Feature: Miriel
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/2f352c83a9ef64ec63dca77a6631fe5211265fe2.png"]

Miriel is an angel who appears when you run out of lives

She will revive you with 1 heart, and you can choose between 2 bonuses.

This is inspired by the same revival mechanic from The Bazaar, and aims to give players a last chance to make their build shine.




New item
Icicle | Legendary | Magic, Frosty | 45 gold | 3.2s cooldown | 0 damage | "On trigger: Freeze a random enemy item for 2s. (This can't get reduced CD)"



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567497/6cb5ef778f19f72a37b6dffbe63e4417ecfa36bc.png"]






Other
🔸 Lyra 2nd option rework: Absolute Zero | "Start of Combat: Freeze all enemy items for 2s".

🔸 Matchmaking has been improved.

🔸 Rating gain has now been adjusted to take average opponent rating into account. (You will gain more rating if you faced opponents with higher rating than you). Only below grandmaster.

🔸 You can now see the average opponent rating for your run in the end game screen.

🔸 Potions and Special Items have been added to the item codex!

🔸 Health cap removed. The way you gain Max HP from leveling up has been changed. It is no longer a simple 30% increase, instead an advanced formula is used that increases your max HP by a flat amount + some percentage. The health increase has diminishing returns. The Max HP you gain thoughout the game is roughly the same early game, but a bit more from level 5 onwards.

	Continue from the shop.

	Press "FIGHT".

	Press "Continue" when combat is finished.

🔸 You can now press "R" to reroll.

notes.title: v0.2.7 | 4 New encounters
notes.content:
Patch v0.2.7Greetings, Oaklings.

Preparations on soft-matchmaking has started. 
In some days, it will be activated and match you against other players of similar rank.

The 3 matchmaking buckets will be:

🔸Bronze + Silver

🔸Gold + Emerald + Diamond + Master

🔸Grandmaster

Again, this has not been activated yet but is anticipated to kick in in a week or so.



Potion Market: No longer a guaranteed day 5 encounter. --> Now day 6 encounter, and "Visit the Market" now only offers 5 potions instead of 6.

Dev comment: 

There was something exciting about the encounter spread of day 3, 4, 6, 8, 9. Not having too frequent encounters makes them much more special.

Other than that the day 5 guaranteed potion shop was extremely polarizing. Either people LOVED IT or they absolutely hated it. It was also very hard to balance as some items benefited astronomically by having it as a guaranteed encounter.
